interlock.name: Interlock and landscaping
interlock.description: We lay pathways, patios, raised gardens, bar tops and fireplaces in interlock stone.
interlock.answer: Henike Contracting lays pathways, patios, raised gardens, bar tops and fireplaces in interlock stone. We work in Gloucester, Orleans and Winchester.

layers.text: The area of the project is excavated based on the geographical location of the project and the intended use of the space.

layers.name: Edge restraint
layers.text: A rigid structural band is placed a long the open exposed ends to reduce material shifting.

interlock.ask: Ask about a patio or walkway

faq.question: How does an interlock job start?
faq.answer: With excavation. The area is excavated based on the geographical location of the project and the intended use of the space.

faq.question: What holds the edge of an interlock patio?
faq.answer: An edge restraint, a rigid structural band, is placed along the open exposed ends to reduce material shifting.

faq.question: What decking materials do you use?
